task.summary:
test: remove obsolete MoDiffHighlight test files
Remove integration and unit test files that are no longer maintained or used in the current test suite. These files contain duplicate test coverage and outdated test patterns that have been superseded by newer test implementations.
Removed files: - DiffHighlightIntegrationTests.cs - EdgeCasesAndErrorHandlingTests.cs - MoDiffHighlightTests.cs - MyersDiffAlgorithmTests.cs

chore: add IDE configuration files for JetBrains
Add JetBrains IDE configuration files (.idea directory) with VCS mappings, gitignore rules, index layout, workspace settings, and encoding configuration for the MoLibrary project.

feat: add JobScheduler UI module with Blazor pages
Add comprehensive UI module for job scheduler management with Blazor components and services:
- Create MoLibrary.JobScheduler.UI project with Razor pages for job definitions, instances, and detailed views - Implement query services: JobDefinitionQueryService, JobInstanceQueryService, JobStatisticsService, JobHealthMetricsService - Add filter request models for advanced querying with pagination - Create reusable Blazor components: JobHealthMetricsCard, JobStatisticsCard, StateHistoryViewer - Add JobSchedulerUIService facade for unified UI access - Implement module registration with ModuleJobSchedulerUI, ModuleJobSchedulerUIOption, ModuleJobSchedulerUIGuide - Extend JobSchedulerApiService with response wrapping and advanced filtering capabilities - Add GetJobInstancesAsync and GetJobInstancesCountAsync to IMoJobScheduleMetadataStore for pagination support - Update EMoModules enum to include JobSchedulerUI - Integrate MudBlazor components for professional UI

refactor: standardize page route constants to PAGE_URL
Unified route constant naming across Razor pages and modules by renaming specific constants (TIMEKEEPER_DEBUG_URL, SYSTEM_INFO_URL, DATACHANNEL_MANAGE_URL, CONFIGURATION_CLIENT_URL, CONFIGURATION_DASHBOARD_URL) to PAGE_URL. Replaced @page directives with @attribute [Route(PAGE_URL)] for consistency. Updated module registrations to reference new constant names. Uncommented and enabled JobScheduler UI page registrations. Fixed syntax in JobStatisticsCard.razor. Added JobScheduler.UI project reference.

build: remove unused dependencies and add StateStore project
- Remove MCP configuration file - Remove Hangfire.HttpJob and Hangfire.Redis.StackExchange library projects - Remove MoLibrary.BackgroundJob project - Add MoLibrary.StateStore.StackExchange project with build configurations

refactor: rename Configuration.Dashboard to Configuration.UI
Rename MoLibrary.Configuration.Dashboard namespace and project to MoLibrary.Configuration.UI for better semantic clarity. Updates all namespaces, imports, and project references throughout the codebase to reflect the new naming convention.
refactor: rename Tests directory to tests

refactor: extract common project properties to shared config
Extract duplicate PropertyGroup settings (TargetFramework, ImplicitUsings, Nullable) from test project files and centralize them in common.xml to reduce duplication and improve maintainability.

feat: remove Dapr configuration provider support
- Remove Dapr.Client and Dapr.Extensions.Configuration package references - Remove Dapr-related using statements and imports - Comment out Dapr configuration initialization logic - Remove UseDaprProvider and DaprStoreName properties - Clean up unused using directives

feat: upgrade to .NET 10 and update NuGet packages (10)
- Migrate target framework from net8.0 to net10.0 - Update AspNetCore packages to 10.0.1 - Update EntityFrameworkCore packages to 10.0.1 - Update MediatR to 14.0.0 - Update Microsoft.CodeAnalysis to 5.0.0 - Update Serilog.AspNetCore to 10.0.0 - Update test SDK packages to latest versions - Improve XML formatting in project files - Add missing PrivateAssets attributes to test packages

refactor: clean up project dependencies and formatting
- Remove unused NuGet packages from MoLibrary.Framework - Consolidate test dependencies into Test.MoLibrary project - Standardize indentation to tabs across project files - Update Test.MoLibrary.Core to use shared test packages - Add missing test utilities (NSubstitute, FluentAssertions, xunit)

refactor: remove unused System.Linq.Async package and consolidate dependencies
Removed System.Linq.Async v6.0.1 from multiple project files (AutoModel, Configuration, DependencyInjection, StateStore) as it's no longer needed. Consolidated the dependency in DomainDrivenDesign project where it's actually used. Also standardized formatting with tabs and removed unnecessary blank lines across project files for consistency.

refactor: migrate profiling module to separate project
- Move MoProfiling from Framework.Features to standalone MoLibrary.Profiling project - Create new MoLibrary.Profiling.csproj with required dependencies - Reorganize namespaces from MoLibrary.Framework.Features.MoProfiling to MoLibrary.Profiling.Profiling - Update ModuleProfiling and solution file references - Remove README.md from Framework features

refactor: simplify OpenAPI endpoint configuration (#10)
Refactor OpenAPI endpoint metadata configuration to use newer .NET 10 minimal APIs. Replace `WithOpenApi()` lambda-based configuration with dedicated extension methods: `WithTags()`, `WithSummary()`, and `WithDescription()`. Remove unnecessary `Microsoft.OpenApi.Models` imports and `OpenApiTag` list creation. Update Swagger configuration to use new OpenAPI abstractions. Remove deprecated `GroupNameToTagsOperationFilter` and update related filter imports.
feat: add TTL-based caching to config centre

refactor: unify configuration API and merge dashboard/client services
- Introduce `IMoConfigurationApi` interface to unify configuration management across centre and client modes - Create `ConfigurationClientApiProvider` for client-mode operations - Create `ConfigurationCentreApiProvider` extending client provider for centre-mode operations with service invocation - Replace `ConfigurationDashboardService` and `ConfigurationClientService` with unified `ConfigurationUIService` - Merge `ModuleConfigurationDashboard` into `ModuleConfigurationUI` - Remove `ModuleConfigurationService` and move endpoints to UI module - Rename `MemoryProviderForConfigCentre` to `ConfigurationCentreApiProvider` - Update all components to use `ConfigurationUIService` instead of separate dashboard/client services - Simplify service registration based on centre/client mode - Update API endpoint conventions to use consistent naming - Remove `IMoConfigurationCentre` interface in favor of unified API
